# Tauri (desktop app)

These rules add to the core build skills of Shipwright.

## Rules

- Every command exposed to the page (#[tauri::command]) validates its arguments: paths resolved then checked against the allowed folders, sizes bounded, never a system command built from input.
- Per-window permissions in src-tauri/capabilities, narrowed by scopes (folders, commands, hosts); never fs, shell or http granted whole.
- Content security policy set in tauri.conf.json, without 'unsafe-eval' or a wildcard source; no remote page receives the app's permissions.
- Heavy work runs on the Rust side in an async task, with progress events; the window never freezes.
- Window state remembered (window-state plugin); minimum size set in the configuration.
- Data in the system's application folder (app_data_dir), secrets in the system keychain; nothing next to the executable.
- Updates with the updater plugin: public key in the configuration, private key only in CI, https endpoints.
- Windows signing and macOS notarisation done in CI; no key or certificate in the repository.
- Never run a project generator with --force in a non-empty folder.
- To check the interface in the real window on Windows: start the app with WEBVIEW2_ADDITIONAL_BROWSER_ARGUMENTS=--remote-debugging-port=9222, then qp flows --attach 9222 and qp deslop --attach 9222.

## Check commands

Used by `/sw:audit`. `{pm}` is the project's package manager, `{url}` the app URL, `{host}` its host name.

| Check | Command | Passes if |
| --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | `{pm} exec tsc --noEmit && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml` | exit code 0 for both |
| lint | `{pm} run lint && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings` | exit code 0, no warning |
| test_run | `{pm} test && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml` | exit code 0 for both |
| deps_audit | `{pm} audit --audit-level=high && cargo audit --file src-tauri/Cargo.lock` | no high or critical advisory (cargo audit needs `cargo install cargo-audit`) |
| license_check | `npx --yes license-checker-rseidelsohn --summary --failOn 'GPL;AGPL'` | exit code 0; check Rust crates with cargo-deny if the app is distributed |
